description: Return exactly ten stations by share and break any tie at the tenth position arbitrarily.

c.request: What are the top 10 observatory stations (`observstation`) by share of all telescopes? For each one, show the station, how many telescopes it has, and its share of the total telescope count, without rounding, ordered from the largest share down. Return exactly ten stations by share and break any tie at the tenth position arbitrarily.
c.sql: SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS telescope_share FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation ORDER BY telescope_share DESC LIMIT 10;

a.request: For each observatory station (`observstation`), count its telescopes and compute its share of all telescopes (its count divided by the total number of telescopes). Show the station, its telescope count, and its share, without rounding, sorted by share from highest to lowest. Return exactly 10 stations, breaking ties at the cutoff arbitrarily.
a.sql: SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count, COUNT(t.telescregistry) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0) AS share FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10;

b.request: Return exactly 10 observatory stations ranked by their share of all telescope records, breaking ties arbitrarily; for each, show `observstation`, its telescope count, and its unrounded count divided by the total telescope count, ordered by share descending
b.sql: SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count, COUNT(t.telescregistry) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0) AS share FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10;

d.request: What are the top 10 observatory stations (`observstation`) by share of all telescopes? For each station, show its name, telescope count, and unrounded share of the total telescope count, ordered by share descending. Return exactly ten stations, breaking any tie at the tenth position arbitrarily.
d.sql: SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS telescope_share FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation ORDER BY telescope_share DESC LIMIT 10;
